notes.title: Version 0.9.9h patch
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
Here's a quick minor patch of tiny tweaks and fixes.

Version 0.9.9h changes:

- Cloud Loading was implemented. [b]Be aware that the game will now overwrite your local copy with the one in the Cloud when it is opened.[/b] Should you have multiple computers with save data running the game, both will be synchronised to the save data stored in Steam Cloud when you open v0.9.9h next.
- Evaluation screen now shows scores with commas
- High scores that exceed 1 billion points no longer overlap the name display in Story Mode
- Made Nanamia silver trophy obtainable
- Trophies should now be consistently obtainable in Spell Practice
- Fixed a bug concerning Assist options that would cause non-integer scores to occur
- Hopefully fixed errant bug involving bell damage objects not generating seemingly at random
- Removed revenge bullet behavior from Ultra Mode patterns involving enemies that surround the player in Stage 5 and in the pattern "Aletheian Aptitude"
- Updated the BGM file for "Praecantor's Chime of Kairos"
- Enabled beta translations for Spanish and Japanese in the Options menu (You may encounter visual bugs!)
- Green Label high score board now visible
- Fixed a bug where the "My Score" Steam Leaderboards view pulled up the score 5 places after yours and nobody else
- Adjusted some Valediction Stage enemy patterns to be a little less overwhelming
- Also made those patterns actually less challenging on Casual Mode
- Casual mode scaling now exists for the attacks "Beasts' Rising from the Primordial Ooze," "Crown of Avalant"
- Adjusted firing pattern of "Beasts' Rising from the Primordial Ooze"
- Valediction now allows for up to 40 hits before setting your Evasion bonus to 10 points, instead of 8
- Cleaned up some debug settings that were left in the build

Please post in the community discussions or feel free to join the Lunacy Indeterminate Discord Server (https://discord.gg/gARjCvhn) if you encounter any issues with the update. Thank you!
